pairs.subject: translation-pipeline-topology
pairs.evidence: scripts/i18n/catalog-check.mjs:303 The per-unit loop over every target string checks key presence, ICU syntax, carried literals and placeholder parity, but never compares a target value with its source value or reads an allowlist, so a value copied over from en passes as translated and the green gate amounts to key parity rather than coverage.

techniques.evidence: scripts/i18n/catalog-check.mjs:303 No value-equality comparison against en and no committed allowlist of legitimately identical values anywhere in checkCatalogs or i18n-check.mjs (grep for identical/untranslated finds only unrelated comments). Key parity plus next-intl's typed Messages contract is exactly the ambiguity the technique names.

scripts/i18n-check.mjs:148 The gate takes its locale set from the messages/ folder instead of i18n/locales.ts LOCALES, and line 105 re-declares DEFAULT_LOCALE = "en". A catalog file with no LOCALES entry gets gated but never offered, and a LOCALES entry with no catalog never reaches this gate.
